children: -- Partners Value Investments L.P. (the “Partnership”, TSXV:PVF.UN, PVF.PR.U) announced today its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. All amounts are stated in United States dollars ("US dollars").

For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Partnership recorded net income of $21 million, of which $19 million was attributable to the Equity Limited Partners, and $2 million to Preferred Limited Partners. For the three months ended September 30, 2025, the Partnership recorded net income of $27 million, of which $25 million was attributable to the Equity Limited Partners, and $2 million to Preferred Limited Partners. The decrease in net income was primarily due to foreign currency translation losses, higher preferred share dividends, higher current tax expense, and lower investment valuation gains, partially offset by higher investment income and deferred tax recovery.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Partnership recorded net income of $67 million, of which $60 million was attributable to Equity Limited Partners and $7 million to Preferred Limited Partners. For the nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Partnership recorded net income of $46 million, of which $39 million was attributable to Equity Limited Partners and $7 million to Preferred Limited Partners. The increase in net income was primarily due to higher investment income, foreign currency translation gains, and deferred tax recovery, partially offset by higher financing costs, higher preferred share dividends and current tax expense.

As at September 30, 2026, the market price of a Brookfield Corporation (“BN”, NYSE/TSX: BN) share and a Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. (“BAM”, NYSE/TSX: BAM) share was $36.46 and $44.58, respectively. As at November 13, 2026, the market price of a BN share and a BAM share was $40.97 and $51.53, respectively.

The Partnership’s principal investments are its interest in approximately 181 million Class A Limited Voting Shares of BN and approximately 29 million Class A Limited Voting Shares of BAM, which it received pursuant to the spin-off of Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. from Brookfield Corporation in 2022 (collectively, the "Brookfield Shares"). This represents approximately an 8% interest in BN and a 2% interest in BAM as at September 30, 2026. In addition, the Partnership owns a diversified investment portfolio of marketable securities and private fund interests.
